# NOTICE: lunar reference-station source material

This directory and `tests/fixtures/lunar_station_published/` contain **no third-party document**. They hold:

- `SOURCES.md`: a register of the public sources S1 to S6 (title, URL, publisher, retrieval date,
  SHA-256, licence);
- numbers transcribed from those sources by hand, each with its page, table or figure reference
  (`../lunar_station_published/CLAIMS.md`);
- this project's own pre-registration and results.

No logo, figure, image or colour scheme from any source is reproduced.

## No affiliation

Kshana is not affiliated with or endorsed by ESA, IOAG, UNOOSA, the ICG, arXiv or any author of these
sources. "NovaMoon" and "Moonlight" are named only where a source is quoted. Kshana's term is "lunar
reference station". Nothing in this directory states or implies anything about the performance of any
real system.
